title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along Saint Joseph corridors near the College of Saint Benedict, each paired with one directly sourced reason to go.

cards.title: A Kitchen-Baked Coffee Stop
cards.subtitle: Minnesota Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk west along Minnesota Street for coffee, then scan the in-house bakery case for breads, muffins, scones, or cookies.
cards.short_summary: Coffee and an on-site bakery anchor this Minnesota Street stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The Local Blend’s official site identifies its location as 19 West Minnesota Street and says its in-house kitchen makes baked goods and other food.
cards.access_notes: The official site currently lists daily daytime hours; confirm them before leaving campus.

cards.title: Local Food Meets Local Art
cards.subtitle: Minnesota Street corridor
cards.notes: Continue along Minnesota Street to browse locally produced food and work by regional artists inside the historic grocery building.
cards.short_summary: A downtown cooperative combines groceries, art, and sustainable-living education.
cards.evidence_claim: The market’s official site describes a community-owned food-and-art cooperative at 27 West Minnesota Street selling local food and local artwork.
cards.access_notes: Public retail business; check the official site for current shopping hours.

cards.title: A Landmark on Minnesota Street
cards.subtitle: Minnesota Street corridor
cards.notes: Pause at 12 West Minnesota Street to view the named parish landmark from the public corridor; contact the church before entering.
cards.short_summary: The parish building provides a clearly identifiable architectural destination downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: The Church of Saint Joseph’s official website lists the parish at 12 West Minnesota Street in Saint Joseph.
cards.source_title: Church of Saint Joseph — St. Joseph, Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is available from the public street; verify church access or service times directly.

cards.title: A Scoop on College Avenue
cards.subtitle: College Avenue North corridor
cards.notes: Head north on College Avenue for ice cream, shaved ice, or a shake; use the shop’s current contact page to time your walk.
cards.short_summary: This College Avenue storefront centers its menu on cold treats.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wandering Cow’s official pages place its family-friendly ice-cream shop at 14 College Avenue North, Suite B, and list ice cream, shaved ice, and shakes.
cards.access_notes: The official contact page currently lists service through 9 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 8 p.m. Sunday; recheck before visiting.

cards.title: Pastries Paired with Flowers
cards.subtitle: College Avenue North corridor
cards.notes: Follow College Avenue North to compare the day’s pastries with locally grown bouquets; check the posted schedule before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A bakery-and-flower shop gives this College Avenue block a two-part browsing stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Flour & Flower’s official site locates the bakery at 24 North College Avenue and says it offers pastries, artisan baked goods, and locally grown flower bouquets.
cards.source_title: Flour & Flower Bakery | Fresh Cut Flowers | St. Joseph, MN
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by day, and Monday pizza service follows a separate calendar; verify the official schedule.

cards.title: A Century-Scale Specialty Counter
cards.subtitle: First Avenue Northwest corridor
cards.notes: Turn onto First Avenue Northwest to browse the retail counter’s fresh meats and house-made sausages during posted business hours.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding specialty meat shop occupies this First Avenue block.
cards.evidence_claim: The market’s official site says it has served central Minnesota for almost a century, while its contact page lists the retail store at 26 First Avenue Northwest.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists 6 a.m.–6 p.m. Monday–Friday, 6 a.m.–5 p.m. Saturday, and no Sunday hours; confirm before travel.

cards.title: Letterpress on Fifth Avenue
cards.subtitle: Fifth Avenue Southeast corridor
cards.notes: Walk the Fifth Avenue Southeast corridor to the studio address, then consult its events page before planning any interior visit.
cards.short_summary: A working letterpress studio makes this residential-edge corridor visually distinctive.
cards.evidence_claim: Bruno Press’s official contact page lists its studio at 154 Fifth Avenue Southeast, and its official site documents letterpress printing and workshops.
cards.access_notes: This is a working studio; attend only during a posted public event or after arranging access directly.

cards.title: A Wooded Watab River Walk
cards.subtitle: County Road 75 West corridor
cards.notes: Take the County Road 75 West corridor to follow the wooded walking trail by the Watab River and locate the park’s recreation areas.
cards.short_summary: A 35-acre park adds a river trail and outdoor recreation to the western corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of St. Joseph identifies Millstream Park at 725 County Road 75 West and describes a wooded walking trail along the Watab River.
cards.access_notes: The city lists multiple public park features; shelter rental has separate hours, fees, and reservation requirements.

cards.title: A Destination Play Park
cards.subtitle: Dale Street East corridor
cards.notes: Follow Dale Street East to inspect the city’s newly installed playground area and loop through the park’s other public amenities.
cards.short_summary: A major 2026 playground renewal gives the east-side corridor a concrete destination.
cards.evidence_claim: The city facilities directory places Klinefelter Park at 1000 Dale Street East, and a May–June 2026 city notice reports new playground equipment installation.
cards.source_title: City of St. Joseph May/June 2026 Newsletter
cards.access_notes: Use the park as a public outdoor destination; consult the city for current construction or facility notices.

cards.title: Nine Features on Birch Street
cards.subtitle: Birch Street West corridor
cards.notes: Walk Birch Street West to connect the playground, benches, drinking fountain, and other city-listed amenities in one park stop.
cards.short_summary: A compact municipal park creates a recreation break on the north side of downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of St. Joseph’s official facilities directory lists Centennial Park at 205 Birch Street West and identifies playground equipment, benches, a drinking fountain, and six additional features.
cards.access_notes: Public city park; check posted signs and city notices for current conditions or amenity restrictions.
